title: inexpensive quality
text:
inexpensive quality. Didn't care for this comforter. It was very inexpensive so I should have known better. $29. for a twin.
The stitching is too far apart so all the fill balls up in one place after only one washing. Too bulky to return....I'll try to make more stitching on it so the filling doesn't all ball up in one spot.

product_metadata.title: Utopia Bedding All Season 250 GSM Comforter - Plush Siliconized Fiberfill Comforters Queen Size - Box Stitched (Full/Queen, Gray)
